notes: Severity assignment for the hackathon prototype. Rules use personal-baseline statistical signals, plan adherence and an illustrative symptom list. No population clinical thresholds are encoded. Every rule must be replaced or approved by a qualified flight surgeon using the mission's approved medical protocols before any real use.

defaults.source: ASTRAHEALTH prototype rule (demonstration only). Requires review against NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1 and mission medical protocols.

rules.description: Configured urgent symptom: chest pain, fainting or confusion reported
rules.title: Urgent symptom reported
rules.next_step: Stop current activity and contact the onboard medical officer now. Follow the mission's emergency medical procedure.
rules.escalation_action: Immediate onboard medical officer escalation; notify ground flight surgeon when communication allows.
rules.source: Illustrative symptom list (demo). Must be replaced by the mission's approved emergency medical protocol.

rules.description: Configured urgent symptom combination: shortness of breath together with dizziness
rules.title: Urgent symptom combination reported
rules.next_step: Stop current activity and contact the onboard medical officer now. Follow the mission's emergency medical procedure.
rules.escalation_action: Immediate onboard medical officer escalation; notify ground flight surgeon when communication allows.
rules.source: Illustrative symptom combination (demo). Must be replaced by the mission's approved emergency medical protocol.

rules.description: Vision change or severe headache reported
rules.title: Symptom needs medical officer review
rules.next_step: Report this symptom to the onboard medical officer today for assessment.
rules.escalation_action: Medical officer review within the current shift.

rules.description: Single heart-rate reading far from personal baseline
rules.title: Heart rate differs from your baseline
rules.next_step: Repeat the heart-rate measurement at rest and record the measurement context.
rules.escalation_action: Track in routine monitoring; escalate to REVIEW if the change persists.

rules.description: Heart rate away from personal baseline for 3 consecutive days
rules.title: Persistent heart-rate change
rules.next_step: Share this trend with the onboard medical officer for review.
rules.escalation_action: Medical officer review; include trend in next ground medical conference.

rules.description: Single blood-pressure reading far from personal baseline
rules.title: Blood pressure differs from your baseline
rules.next_step: Repeat the blood-pressure measurement at rest, recording posture and device.
rules.escalation_action: Track in routine monitoring.

rules.description: Blood pressure away from personal baseline for 3 consecutive days
rules.title: Persistent blood-pressure change
rules.next_step: Share this trend with the onboard medical officer for review.
rules.escalation_action: Medical officer review.

rules.description: Body temperature differs from personal baseline
rules.title: Temperature differs from your baseline
rules.next_step: Repeat the temperature measurement with the same method and note any symptoms.
rules.escalation_action: Track; escalate if symptoms are present.

rules.description: Cardiovascular-related symptom reported (not in the urgent list)
rules.title: Cardiovascular-related symptom reported
rules.next_step: Tell the onboard medical officer about this symptom today; repeat heart-rate and blood-pressure measurements at rest.
rules.escalation_action: Medical officer review.

rules.description: One self-reported wellbeing score far from usual
rules.title: Wellbeing check-in differs from usual
rules.next_step: Consider a short break, a planned call home or a private check-in with the crew medical officer if helpful.
rules.escalation_action: Track over the next check-ins.

rules.description: Adverse multi-day trend in one wellbeing score
rules.title: Wellbeing trend
rules.next_step: Keep completing daily check-ins; a private conversation with the medical officer is available at any time.
rules.escalation_action: Track; escalate if several measures change together.

rules.description: Several wellbeing measures trending adversely together
rules.title: Several wellbeing measures changing together
rules.next_step: A private, supportive conversation with the crew medical officer or behavioral health support is recommended.
rules.escalation_action: Medical officer review; offer behavioral health support per mission protocol.

rules.description: Neurological-type symptom reported
rules.title: Symptom reported
rules.next_step: Note when the symptom started and whether it changes; tell the medical officer if it persists or worsens.
rules.escalation_action: Track.

rules.description: Sleep below personal baseline
rules.title: Sleep below your usual
rules.next_step: Review tonight's sleep schedule and environment (light, noise, temperature) and log the next sleep period.
rules.escalation_action: Track.

rules.description: Repeated short sleep periods
rules.title: Repeated short sleep
rules.next_step: Protect the next scheduled sleep period and discuss the pattern at the next medical check-in.
rules.escalation_action: Track; included in cross-domain review.

rules.description: Exercise adherence below mission plan
rules.title: Exercise below plan
rules.next_step: Review the countermeasure schedule and log today's planned session.
rules.escalation_action: Track; discuss with the exercise specialist if it continues.

rules.description: Resistance sessions missed
rules.title: Resistance sessions missed
rules.next_step: Schedule the next resistance session and mark it complete when done.
rules.escalation_action: Track.

rules.description: Musculoskeletal discomfort reported
rules.title: Musculoskeletal discomfort
rules.next_step: Note the location and activity that triggers it; tell the medical officer if it persists or limits exercise.
rules.escalation_action: Track.

rules.description: Logged fluid intake below personal baseline
rules.title: Fluid intake below your usual
rules.next_step: Check that today's intake is fully logged and follow the mission nutrition plan.
rules.escalation_action: Track.

rules.description: Appetite below personal baseline
rules.title: Appetite below your usual
rules.next_step: Log meals for the next few days so changes can be tracked.
rules.escalation_action: Track.

rules.description: Body mass differs from personal baseline
rules.title: Body mass change
rules.next_step: Repeat the mass measurement under the standard procedure and share the trend at the next medical check-in.
rules.escalation_action: Track; medical officer review if the change persists.

rules.description: Multivariate statistical anomaly (alone)
rules.title: Unusual combination of signals
rules.next_step: Review the contributing signals and repeat any measurement taken without context.
rules.escalation_action: Track; escalates when specialist agents also flag changes.

rules.description: Persistent change point in a signal
rules.title: Persistent shift in a trend
rules.next_step: Look at the trend view for the affected signals.
rules.escalation_action: Track.

rules.description: Cross-domain pattern: an anomaly plus monitor-level findings from two or more specialist agents
rules.title: Several health areas changing together
rules.next_step: Share this report with the onboard medical officer for review.
rules.escalation_action: Medical officer review of the consolidated report.

rules.description: Observation flagged by DataGuard (implausible, duplicate, stale or unconfirmed)
rules.title: Measurement needs confirmation
rules.next_step: Confirm or repeat the flagged measurement; it is excluded from analysis until then.
rules.escalation_action: Crew member confirms or corrects.

rules.description: An analysis agent failed
rules.title: Analysis incomplete
rules.next_step: Analysis coverage is incomplete. Re-run the analysis; if it fails again, ask the medical officer to review the raw measurements.
rules.escalation_action: Human review of the uncovered measurements.

rules.description: Agents disagree about the same metric
rules.title: Conflicting analysis results
rules.next_step: The analysis modules disagree; the medical officer should review the underlying measurements.
rules.escalation_action: Human review; conflicts are never averaged away.
